# newreleases_telegram_chats (Data Source)

Lists Telegram chats connected to the account. Use their IDs in `newreleases_project.telegram_chats`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "newreleases_telegram_chats" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `chats` (Attributes List) Connected Telegram chats. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chats))

<a id="nestedatt--chats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chats`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Chat ID.
- `name` (String) Chat name.
- `type` (String) Chat type, for example `private` or `group`.
